That's near-balanced churn rather than a collapse, and 375 distinct buyers in that window is real participation. The first two minutes showed 402 buyers and 197 SOL with a 5-buyer concentration of only 16%, so early distribution wasn't dominated by a few wallets, and no airdrop dump was seen. Pool depth of 52.7 SOL gives some exit liquidity.

Counterpoint I can't ignore: the 77% drawdown from the 30-minute high and the -32% last-15-minute return mean this is a coin already bleeding, with sellers matching buyers. A dip-buy only works if the bleeding stops within the 30-60 minute window, and the brief gives no evidence of a bottom. The curve, class, and name fields are unresolved, so the operator and factory status are unknown.

Verdict: the case is thin. Churn at this volume is the only honest bull point, and it doesn't outweigh a 77% drawdown with net selling. I would skip.
